verdict.rationale: Ultrametric is a process service that agents call, not an agent itself, so the MCP-server axis applies. Its docs describe an official hosted remote MCP server at https://api.ultrametric.ai/mcp, with authentication scopes and a tools reference (e.g. `status`). Probes confirm the endpoint is live and returns a standards-compliant OAuth protected-resource (RFC 9728) auth wall; requiring sign-in is expected behavior, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: no observed authenticated initialize/tools/list session confirming the tools work end to end, and only thin evidence of the full MCP tool catalog. [2026-10-14 re-judge parity audit (owner-product lane): quality re-capped 8 -> 7, the cap both audits applied: the judge's own citations include the 401 AUTH_REQUIRED wall (ultrametric-audit-20261014-2, selfeval-5) and no initialize/tools/list session has ever been observed; a never-observed handshake cannot out-grade the documented-wall state graded full 7 medium twice. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
